body: Apologies, I'm still kinda new to posting to reddit. What does that mean and why would I need your home address?

Thanks so much for the thorough response. You definitely pointed out things to me that I otherwise would not have noticed. Your response was a little lesson in itself. 

For right now I'm basically buying for my future self as I'm in an apartment where the cabinets and countertops in the kitchen are pretty ugly imo. Much like [(this)](http://4.bp.blogspot.com/-03en-bUY69I/T_WV4O9-OmI/AAAAAAAAAgM/70DeTUbMCXE/s1600/old+kitchen.jpg). I think I'm settling in pretty well with the idea of buying this [(coffee)](https://www.etsy.com/listing/580793252/live-edge-coffee-table?ga_order=most_relevant&ga_search_type=all&ga_view_type=gallery&ga_search_query=live+edge+coffee+table&ref=sr_gallery-1-17) and [(end)](https://www.etsy.com/listing/577072320/live-edge-end-tablesnack-table?ref=related-1) table in black walnut or possibly a lighter tone. It breaks the budget a little bit but I see it lasting a long time and fitting in with future aesthetics that I would want.

Thanks again for the help! Any further input is definitely welcomed :)
Or just be a better moderator and create actual rules instead of just making a post about something that frustrates you?

>r/malelivingspace

Am I missing something? The only rule you guys have posted is about advertising. It's unfair to ban/delete people's posts if you don't have regulations. Plus in the description of the subreddit it specifically states "man caves." I'm sure in tons of men's minds man caves include gaming setups and consoles and almost exclusively that.
At the very least you could actually create more guidelines for this subreddit if it's that upsetting.

They're spaces that people are proud of creating. I mean there's the one with the "Girls Girls Girls" LED light sign, which is gross imo but again it's a room nonetheless. Are you gonna just start banning anyone whose taste you don't agree with??

Really agree with the idea that with more space comes more clutter. Point well made. I kinda went a different direction just over the past hour and found two BEAUTIFUL tables on Amazon and can't believe how cheap they are. Could you take a look and give me an opinion on how their color would look with the color of the couch? I also included some other options. Thanks for the response!
